business_summary: Saurer Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of intelligent textile equipment and core components for fiber and yarn processing in Europe, Africa, India, America, Turkey, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers blowroom and carding pre-spinning machines; roving, automation, ring, compact, rotor, and air spinning machines; and carpet yarn, glass filament yarn, industrial yarn, staple fibre yarn, and tire cord yard twisting and cabling machines. It also provides Senses data analyzing tool that consists of various elements, such as Senses Maintenance which digitalizes maintenance processes for machines; Senses Workforce that digitalizes personnel management; Senses Data Transfer, which allows usage of data for the daily optimization of business processes; Senses Shop Floor that optimizes production facility by shortening distances for operators; and Senses recipe, which digitalizes recipe management. In addition, the company offers bearings for airjet spinning, short staple ring spinning, rotor spinning, and winding; drafting systems for roving frames, short staple ring frames, and worsted ring spinning; complete spindles; and rings and travellers. Further, it provides at-line and laboratory instruments and monitoring systems for filament yarns (POY/FDY), industrial yarns, BCF, DTY, and ATY; at-line and laboratory instruments online monitoring systems; Automatic can transport system, Bobbin transport system, Cone transport, and Palletiser; and CreelFlow supply package transport system, PackFlow twist package transport system, Palletiser, and Robot AGV. The company was formerly known as Xinjiang Urban Construction (Group) Co., Ltd. Saurer Intelligent Technology Co. Ltd was founded in 1853 and is based in Urumqi, China.
